title: Mareos Guest House Rincón Beach • Surf • Nightlife

images.caption: Living Room: Your perfect oasis in our bright living space! Kick back on our cozy sofa, and stream shows on the Smart TV. Looking for laughs? Break out the classic board games for some fun—including Jenga, Tic-Tac-Toe and our giant Monopoly!
Kitchen & Dining: Cook up your favorite meals in our fully equipped kitchen and enjoy them together at the cozy dining table. Everything you need to feel right at home during your stay!
Master Bedroom: Your ultimate sanctuary! Sink into the plush Queen bed after a day at the beach, enjoy refreshing A/C, and drift off under cozy ambient lights. Your dream night's sleep starts here!
Second Bedroom: The ultimate shared retreat! Featuring two comfy beds with fresh linens, refreshing A/C, and plenty of space to unwind together after a fun day exploring Rincón.
Modern Bathroom: Clean and bright! Enjoy a refreshing shower in our well-appointed bathroom featuring a modern vanity, fresh towels, and a hair dryer for your convenience. Your private oasis!

Your Private Balcony: Step out to your own serene outdoor space! Enjoy morning coffee at the charming bistro set while taking in the lush tropical views. A quiet, fresh-air escape perfect for starting your day in Rincón.
Property Exterior: Welcome to Mareo's Guest House! Front view of the property showing the private entrance and exterior area.
Rafael Hernández Airport, located less than 30 minutes from the house.

Tres Palmas Sunset Serenity: Experience this daily spectacle, located just a short 5-minute drive from our doorstep. Watch the sun dip into the Caribbean sea, perfectly framed by the iconic palm trees of the world-famous Tres Palmas Marine Reserve.

The Iconic Rincón Lighthouse: Explore the historic Punta Higüera Lighthouse, located just a short drive from our property. Enjoy stunning coastal views, whale watching in season, and beautiful sunsets from this local landmark.

Balneario Serenity: Experience breathtaking sunsets like this at the local beach, just a short drive away. Relax on the golden sands, enjoy the crystal-clear waters, and soak in the true magic of Rincón's coast during your stay.
Welcome to Rincón: Capture the perfect photo at the iconic entrance arch of our beautiful town. Your adventure starts here!
Relaxing Hammock: Unwind on the balcony hammock with a cozy view of the trees. Perfect spot to read or relax.

Convenient Laundry Area: Located on the rear balcony for your convenience, featuring a full washer and dryer set. Keep your clothes fresh and clean throughout your beach adventures and stay in Rincón!

Rincón has a vibrant nightlife with beachfront bars, live music, and a relaxed atmosphere. Don't miss the lively Art Walk every Thursday in the town center—a local favorite, all just minutes away from Mareo’s Guest House.
World-Class Surf Nearby: Catch the waves! Rincón is famous for its incredible surf spots, and you'll be just minutes away from the best local breaks to watch or ride the waves.
Board Games: Family fun guaranteed! We provide classic board games like Monopoly, Twister, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Jenga for your entertainment.
Domino Table: Enjoy a fun game night with friends or family at our dedicated domino table setup.

description: Welcome to Mareo's Guest House, your cozy home in Rincón! Enjoy a spacious 2-bedroom house with private entrance, fully equipped kitchen, living area, and a balcony with a hammock wrapped in cool breezes.🏡 Private entrance🛏️ 2 bedrooms (3 Queen beds)🍳 Fully equipped kitchen🌴 Private balcony with hammock & breeze🚗 Convenient parking📍 Just minutes to beaches & downtown🔑 Self check-inUnwind to sunsets & experience the ultimate tropical escape in Puerto Rico! 🌺The spaceMareo's Guest House is a comfortable, spacious home designed for a relaxing getaway in Rincón.The house features three queen-size beds, comfortably accommodating up to 6 guests. It's the ideal option for families or groups looking for comfort and privacy.Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and cozy living room—perfect for relaxing between beach adventures. Step outside onto your private balcony with a hammock and outdoor dining area, wrapped in cool breezes.The space includes:• 🛏️ 3 Queen-size beds (sleeps 6)• ⚡ Full power backup (generator)• 🚿 1 full bathroom• 🍳 Fully equipped kitchen• 🍽️ Indoor dining area• 🛋️ Comfortable living room• 🌴 Private balcony with hammock• 🪑 Outdoor dining area• ❄️ Air conditioning• 🔑 Private entrance & self check-inEntirely private and independent for your stay!Guest accessGuests have private, exclusive access to the entire 2-bedroom house, allowing you to come and go comfortably during your stay.The house is conveniently located at street level with no steps or stairs to climb to enter the main living area, offering easy and seamless access from the parking space.🚗 Private parking is available for guests.🏡 The entire house is private and exclusively for your group.🔑 Private entrance for convenient access.Other things to notePrivate gated parking is available exclusively for Mareo's Guest House, strictly limited to 2 vehicles.The parking setup features space for one vehicle inside the carport and a second vehicle parked directly behind it, all safely enclosed within our secure gated area.Please note that there is an apartment on the property with its own separate gate and independent entrance. title: Rincon Sunset Penthouse W/ Full Building Generator
description: OCEAN SUNSET PENTHOUSE W/BALCONY & PARKING IN TRANQUIL RINCÓN PR. Beach-town vibes, direct ocean & sunset views, and modern penthouse living await in this sun-drenched 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in laid-back Rincón, Puerto Rico.The spaceNestled on the western tip of the island just one block from the beach and a 5-minute walk from the town center, this top-floor penthouse in an elevator building includes oversized windows, a spacious balcony perfectly situated for outdoor dining and sunset views, and one dedicated outdoor parking spot in a gated lot. Backup generator powers entire building in the event of electricity disruption. Building also has water backup cistern. Aguadilla Airport—with direct flights to NYC, Orlando, Miami, and Ft. Lauderdale—is just a 30 minute drive. The home begins with an open-plan living room, dining room and kitchen with western exposure and a mini-split heating and cooling system. The living area flows out to a covered balcony spanning the entire width of the apartment, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor experience. Guests can enjoy the Smart TVs in every room equipped with access to all streaming platforms – Netflix, Hulu, HBO Max, Peacock, etc. Elegant and refined, the freshly renovated & fully equipped kitchen boasts an eat-in breakfast bar, sleek countertops, custom cabinetry, and high-end stainless steel appliances, including a dishwasher and electric stove. Guests will also receive complimentary locally sourced coffee for their stay. The primary suite has ocean views, a Therapedic king bed, a reach-in closet, and a lovely en-suite bathroom with tiled floors, updated fixtures, and a walk-in-shower. The second bedroom has a Therapedic queen bed, large reach-in closet and adjoins a second full bathroom, with bathtub, for easy access. Both beds are outfitted with luxurious bedding by Brooklinen. In addition, guests are provided with Brooklinen bathrobes and towels for a spa-like experience. Finishing the home is a convenient laundry room with a utility sink and a stacked washer and dryer which can be available to long term guests staying more than one week. Guests of the condo enjoy access to a beautiful pool and peace of mind in a secure, gated building. There are numerous amazing restaurants, cafes, and bars nearby, including La Cambija, Café 413, Isla Made, La Copa Llena, Alma, La Monstera, Gylro, Spires Market, The Harbor and more. A full guidebook is provided in the unit. The Tres Palmas nature reserve and numerous pristine, beaches are also easily accessible. Guests are supplied with beach chairs, beach bags, beach towels, plateware, glassware, cookware, hair dryer, iron and board, basic kitchen items.Other things to noteSorry, no pets allowed.

title: Sandy Beach Studio • Terrace & Parking by Surf
description: Stay just steps from Sandy Beach in this private, peaceful studio designed for travelers who want comfort and convenience close to the action. A private entrance, outdoor terrace, and on-site parking make it easy to come and go at your own pace. Inside, enjoy cool air conditioning, reliable Wi-Fi, and cozy furnishings ideal for couples or solo travelers. Whether you’re here to work remotely, or unwind after exploring, this bright studio offers everything you need for a relaxed stay in Rincón.The spaceDiscover the perfect coastal retreat just steps from Sandy Beach. This private unit offers the ideal balance of comfort, convenience, and a laid-back beach lifestyle. Thoughtfully designed and positioned in one of the most sought-after areas of the coast, it delivers a high-value experience without compromising on simplicity.Enjoy a quiet hideaway near the waves, where mornings begin with a short walk to world-class surf and evenings wind down on your sunset terrace—your own relaxing outdoor space to lounge, sip, and soak in the tropical breeze. Whether you’re here to chase the swells, explore the area, or unwind in total privacy, this unit offers everything you need for a smooth and restful stay.A functional, well-located space with beach access just minutes away—ideal for travelers seeking a peaceful escape close to all the action.Guest accessBlack/Grey lockbox with key is located right next to the doorOther things to noteWe like to keep things easy here — you’ll get all your check-in info and local recommendations through our Hospitri app. Rincon is a laid-back community, so please be respectful of neighbors and enjoy the simple rhythm of island life.

description: Relaxing villa ideal for couples, located in the heart of the Rincon surfing community. This immaculate studio features a comfortable king-size bed, coastal décor, and a bright, peaceful interior. Enjoy a spacious open-air living area with comfortable seating, relaxing hammock , and tropical views, plus a private balcony and access to a shared outdoor deck surrounded by lush gardens. Just minutes from world-class surfing, swimming, snorkeling beaches, and ocean and mountain sunsets.The spaceInside, you’ll find a plush king-size bed dressed with soft 100% cotton linens, The wall-mounted Samsung Smart TV offers complimentary live channels, with access to popular streaming apps using your personal login, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and a ceiling fan to ensure a comfortable stay.The smart kitchenette is equipped with everything you need to prepare breakfast or simple meals, including a microwave, coffee maker, electric kettle, toaster, electric skillet, rice cooker, blender, compact refrigerator, plates, silverware, drinking glasses, coffee mugs, and wine glasses.For your beach adventures, we provide beach towels, beach chairs, umbrella, coolers, and snorkeling equipment so you can make the most of Rincón’s beautiful coastline.Outside, enjoy the property’s lush tropical gardens, where colorful birds are frequent visitors. Relax in the shared outdoor living spaces featuring comfortable seating, ceiling fans, indoor and outdoor dining areas, and a BBQ area perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach while taking in Rincón’s spectacular sunrises and sunsets.Our property is clean, safe, smoke-free, and carefully maintained to provide a peaceful and relaxing experience for every guest.Other things to noteThe property is centrally located within walking distance of a convenience store, artisan pizzeria with craft beer and a sports bar, local coffee shops, smoothie bars, vegan dining, tapas, and casual rum and beer shacks. World-class surfing, swimming, snorkeling, and paddleboarding beaches are only minutes away, making it easy to experience everything that makes Rincón one of Puerto Rico’s most beloved destinations.If you’re looking to explore beyond the beach, public tennis and pickleball courts, as well as a sports center, are just a 10 - 15 minute drive away, while a public golf course can be reached in about 30 minutes. You can also enjoy nearby hiking trails, local art galleries, farmers’ markets, horseback riding, seasonal whale watching (January through March), and countless opportunities to experience the relaxed lifestyle of Puerto Rico’s west coast.A rental car is recommended to make the most of your stay and explore Rincón and the surrounding towns. Free parking is available on the property. As with most tropical destinations, you may occasionally encounter geckos or other harmless island wildlife they’re a natural part of the Caribbean environment.The villa is approximately 40 minutes from Rafael Hernández Airport (BQN) in Aguadilla and about 2.5 hours from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport (SJU) in San Juan. Whenever possible, we recommend flying into BQN for the quickest and most convenient drive.YOU ARE IN GREAT HANDS WITH US

description: Welcome to Rincon Relax, a cozy 2-bedroom house up in a hill, in Rincon that provides a stylish, relaxing experience in a quiet area near downtown Rincon. The Balneario beach is a few minutes away. Ideal for two couples or a small group of friends. Private patio with pool, partial ocean view, and BBQ. Fully equipped for the perfect beach vacation. Bedrooms have ceiling fans and air conditioner. Battery backup for refrigerator and one multiplug, water tank.The spaceRincon Relax is a beautiful house in a cul de sac at the top of a hill, just a three-minute drive from the Balneario (Public) Beach and a short from the downtown bars, restaurants, and entertainment in Downtown. It features an open concept design with a full kitchen, balcony, and backyard with a private pool where you can relax and enjoy. Two bedrooms with one queen-size bed on each one and two full bathrooms. The house is beautifully decorated and features a macrame swing in the receiving area, where you can get a lovely photoshoot. The property also has three SMART Roku TVs so that you can stream your favorite shows with our high-speed internet service.Guest accessThe house has free parking space for two cars in front of the house at no additional cost. If you're up for a hike, you can walk to the beach and downtown.Other things to noteAir conditioner in both rooms and family/dining area. There are also ceiling fans in both guest rooms, as well as in the kitchen and living room. Beach towels and beach chairs are available. The kitchen is fully equipped with an oven, gas stove, air fryer, pots, pans, kitchen utensils, coffee mugs, cups, and silverware. The house is at the top of a hill. Quiet hours begin at 8:00 pm, and no parties are allowed.

description: Villa 2 at Casa Aguas Azules is a 2BR/2BA beachfront villa on Corcega Beach in Rincón, Puerto Rico. Enjoy direct beach access, a shared beachfront pool, and modern Caribbean décor with locally sourced art and unique pieces. Set above a beautiful stone wall with a Mediterranean feel, the villa offers a private, upscale Caribbean experience. Pool and beach areas are shared with The Mansion and Villa 1.The spaceStunning 2BR/2BA beachfront villa on Corcega Beach with sunset views, private beach access, central A/C, WiFi, Smart TV, stocked kitchen, gas BBQ, gated yard, and washer/dryer. Enjoy direct access to the beach and a shared beachfront pool with the main house and Villa 2. Please note: the villa does not have solar, a generator, or backup water. Although it is infrequent, it does happen from time to time.Guest accessVilla 2 at Casa Aguas Azules has a private entrance, and both the villa and balcony are fully private for your stay. Located on the second floor, it offers beautiful views and easy access to the shared beachfront pool and patio, shared with Villa 1 and The Mansion. There are plenty of private lounge areas around the pool, and night swimming is especially enjoyable.Other things to noteWe reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule applyWe are located on the western point of the island. We are2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 35 minutes from both BQN & MAZ airports and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. To avoid the drive from San Juan there is a Cape Air flight that goes direct multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.
amenities: Shared outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours
